headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate public trend signals to improve ClearInstall’s risk assessment capabilities by leveraging AI for more accurate and real-time vulnerability detection. Enhance user experience through automated binding.gyp command expansion checks, and provide detailed insights into potential security risks before installation.
